checks.name: same game and target, both campaigns passed
same production budgets and exact game assets
same complete initial public packet hash
same physical commands, full animation packet hashes and primitive boundaries
same selected source prefix kinds and acquired action counts
same previously reported series projection with observation-scope normalization
partial current-control access is not required in these previous successful prefixes
new labeled acquisition remains empty in prior successful prefixes
same request outcomes and common caller revisions
same final public result and retained-session counters
source frozen during both campaigns and no Python agent modules

qualification: Compares commands, complete public packet hashes, source prefix kinds, acquisition counters and reported series projections. Observation session scope is normalized. Session-derived hashed program model IDs are excluded while their acquisition epochs, normalized evidence and observed/inferred operator counts remain compared. Native graph chains/revisions and shared inherited digests are excluded. Prior acquired-preparation deferrals and guards are compared. New labeled projections must remain empty on these prior successful prefixes; all prior product, radial/control-discovery, quota/native-mark-support, relation and other series evidence remain compared. No partial-access extension is required in these prefixes. Timings are excluded; this is not a speed comparison or full internal-state parity.
